working_definitions.new_channel_proxy: oldest currently public upload is on or after cutoff; Joined date is not used
working_definitions.large_view_threshold: at least one currently public long-form video with >=100000 views
working_definitions.ai_native_evidence: creator self-disclosure in public video metadata plus direct visual review; private workflow cannot be independently audited

method_limits: Deleted, private, or unlisted uploads are not observable, so oldest currently public upload is a lower-bound proxy, not proof of true channel launch date.
Public views are point-in-time outcomes and are not equivalent to impressions, CTR, retention, revenue, or monetization status.
Channel-shelf counts are rounded; representative top-video counts use player metadata.
Creator AI self-disclosure does not prove every production step was automated or generated by AI.
Subscriber count returned by player metadata may lag or be rounded.
